message: I found an injured stray dog on 22nd Street with a limping front leg. Can I bring him in right now?
recommended_action: Contact the sender promptly; confirm intake availability and direct them to a veterinarian or emergency animal service if needed.

message: My landlord is forcing me out by Friday and I cannot keep my senior cat. Need to surrender her.
recommended_action: Contact the sender promptly to discuss surrender options and timing.

message: Submitted my adoption application for Drax yesterday, just checking on next steps and references.
recommended_action: Check the application status and explain the next steps and reference process.

message: I have an acre yard and experience with anxious dogs. I want to offer temporary foster space this month.
recommended_action: Thank the sender and share the foster screening and onboarding process.

message: Does Evy come already spayed and up to date on rabies vaccines before going home?
recommended_action: Verify Evy's medical record and provide accurate spay and rabies vaccination details.

message: We have 4 student volunteers available Saturday morning to assist with dog walking or kennel cleaning.
recommended_action: Confirm whether help is needed Saturday and share volunteer requirements and scheduling details.

message: Hi, I have a purebred dog I might give away, or maybe I will adopt a second dog, not sure yet.
recommended_action: Ask the sender to clarify whether they need rehoming guidance or are interested in adoption.

message: Increase your shelter website traffic by 300% guaranteed with our commercial search engine package!
recommended_action: Mark as spam; no response needed.
